column1: # Module 13 — shell + Bandit. Format: Question¶{{c1::complete answer}}<TAB>tags. Back Extra stays empty. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is the shell's sentence structure?¶{{c1::command --flags arguments — verb, adverbs, objects (ls -la /etc = "list, long and all, /etc")}}
Where is the shell's dictionary?¶{{c1::man CMD}} · {{c1::CMD --help}} · {{c1::help BUILTIN}} — {{c1::reading it beats guessing}}
In the shell, what do pwd, cd -, and cd ~ do?¶{{c1::Where am I}} · {{c1::back to the previous directory}} · {{c1::home}}
What does tail -f do, and when do you use it?¶{{c1::Follows a growing file live — the command you'll use most on real logs}}
In shell paths, what are . / .. / ~ / - ?¶{{c1::Here}} · {{c1::parent}} · {{c1::home}} · {{c1::previous directory}}
In shell globbing, what do * ? and ** match?¶{{c1::Any characters}} · {{c1::exactly one character}} · {{c1::any depth (modern shells)}}
What does a shell pipe | do?¶{{c1::Sends one command's output into the next command's input — a conveyor of small single-purpose machines}}
In the shell, what does 2>&1 mean?¶{{c1::Send stderr (2) wherever stdout (1) currently goes — so pipes and log files capture errors too}}
Why must sort come before uniq -c?¶{{c1::uniq only collapses ADJACENT duplicates, it has no memory of earlier lines — unsorted input silently gives wrong counts}}
What does sort -rn do?¶{{c1::Sorts numerically (-n), reversed (-r) — biggest first}}
Which question does find answer, and which does grep?¶find = {{c1::"which FILES?" (name/type/time/size/permissions)}} · grep = {{c1::"which LINES?" (content)}}
What do grep's flags -r -n -i -l -c -v do?¶{{c1::Recursive}} · {{c1::line numbers}} · {{c1::case-insensitive}} · {{c1::filenames only}} · {{c1::counts}} · {{c1::invert the match}}
What does xargs do?¶{{c1::Feeds a list of items into another command: find . -name '*.log' | xargs wc -l}}
Read the permission string -rw-r--r-- aloud.¶{{c1::Type, then owner rw-, group r--, others r-- → only the owner can write}}
What does chmod 600 secret.txt mean?¶{{c1::Owner read+write; group and others nothing}}
Why does cat -oddly-named fail, and what are the two fixes?¶{{c1::It looks like flags — fixed by cat ./-oddly-named or cat -- -oddly-named}}
What is SSH, in one sentence?¶{{c1::An encrypted remote terminal — you type here, it runs there (ssh user@host -p PORT)}}
What is SSH's first-connect fingerprint prompt for?¶{{c1::The server proving its identity/continuity — accept once, be suspicious if it ever changes unexpectedly}}
What is the Bandit connection line?¶{{c1::ssh bandit0@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220 (level-0 password: bandit0)}}
What is the house rule for Bandit?¶{{c1::No walkthroughs — 30 min struggle, then man pages, then concept-only hints; every walkthrough read is a rep not done}}
Shell translation: what are bash's ls / cat / grep in PowerShell?¶{{c1::Get-ChildItem · Get-Content · Select-String}}
Shell translation: bash reads an env var as $VAR — how does PowerShell read it?¶{{c1::$env:VAR}}
Shell translation: what is bash's /dev/null in PowerShell?¶{{c1::$null}}
What does "labs are the curriculum" mean?¶{{c1::Cyber videos are on-ramps; hands-on labs (Bandit, PortSwigger, DVWA) are where competence forms}}
